title: Fixed-head flux metric semantics reconciliation

trigger.discrepancy: For SWBOTB=5 the persisted Reference BOTTOM_FLUX is a water-balance-materialized interval-average outward flux, while prior Layer-ROM analyses compared it with an instantaneous terminal Darcy flux.

code_authority.laboratory_identity: With qtop=0 and inactive sinks/sources, printed Reference BOTTOM_FLUX = BOTTOM_OUTWARD_EXCHANGE / dt and is an interval-average outward exchange rate.

scope.primary_reconciliation: B1H six-material transfer and B1HC-D same-partition comparison

QAVG.name: interval-average outward bottom flux
QAVG.Reference: BOTTOM_OUTWARD_EXCHANGE / observation_dt; must equal persisted Reference BOTTOM_FLUX within numerical tolerance.
QAVG.CoRichards: BOTTOM_OUTWARD_EXCHANGE / observation_dt; must equal persisted comparator BOTTOM_FLUX within numerical tolerance.
QAVG.LayerROM: increment of prognostic cumulative bottom exchange over one observation interval divided by observation_dt.
QAVG.physical_role: commensurate interval exchange rate; appropriate companion to cumulative recharge/capillary exchange.

QEND.name: terminal end-state zero-head Darcy diagnostic
QEND.Reference: Reconstruct from committed R16 bottom-cell theta using frozen MvG K/psi and the 5-cm half-cell gradient to h_boundary=0.
QEND.CoRichards: Reconstruct from the committed same-partition bottom-cell theta using its 5-cm half-cell gradient.
QEND.LayerROM: Standard qbottom_zero_head from the candidate terminal state.
QEND.physical_role: commensurate end-state flux diagnostic; not the interval water-balance flux.

comparisons.placement: For L4 versus U4 and R8 versus U8 report GW and PROFILE componentwise relations separately. Do not combine them into one score.
comparisons.dimension: For L4 -> L6 -> R8 report nonincreasing status independently for every corrected component.
comparisons.same_partition: For each material and L4/L6/R8 compare Layer-ROM with CoRichards separately on corrected GW and PROFILE vectors.
comparisons.R16_OP: Report R16_OP corrected QAVG/QEND together with storage/profile. Do not call a residual a spatial-closure floor unless E1 and corrected semantics support that attribution.

adjudication_rules.componentwise_no_worse: No component larger than control by more than numerical tolerance, and at least one component strictly smaller.
supersession: All prior fixed-head Layer-ROM bottom_flux_rmse_cm_per_day and bottom_flux_sign_errors using terminal-candidate versus interval-average Reference semantics are superseded for scientific interpretation.
Storage, cumulative exchange and profile components are retained unless an independent inconsistency is found.
Any prior multi-component frontier requiring the superseded flux components is HELD pending a semantics-corrected rerun/re-adjudication.

expected_outputs: per material/member/checkpoint corrected QAVG and QEND errors
corrected targeted-placement GW and PROFILE relations
corrected Layer-ROM versus same-partition CoRichards relations
explicit old-metric to corrected-metric impact table

successor.if_R16_OP_QAVG_and_QEND_converge_with_ex: Reconsider whether temporal refinement is needed before any new closure work.
successor.if_R16_OP_QAVG_or_QEND_remains_material: Preregister a temporal/state-evolution diagnosis using corrected metrics only.
successor.B01_fixed_head: After B1HCF, separately repair B01 B1/B2 fixed-head frontier authority using the same QAVG/QEND semantics before restoring those frontier claims.
